headline: Liquor and lodging license requests for Maitland Farm Kitchen & Spirits and The Windward Inn, plus four one-day liquor licenses.
summary: The Maitland Farm item asks to change its seasonal all alcohol liquor license to an annual one. The four one-day requests include a June 26, 2027 event by North Shore Pride, Inc. that is expected to draw approximately 40,000 people.
items: Change of class from seasonal to annual all alcohol liquor license for Maitland Farm LLC, d/b/a Maitland Farm Kitchen & Spirits, 84-86 Derby Street, Salem
Lodging house license for Windward Hospitality Group LLC, d/b/a The Windward Inn, 19 Washington Square North, Salem
One day liquor license for North Shore Pride, Inc., June 26, 2027, 11am – 5pm, Salem Common, approximately 40,000 people, applicant Hope Watt-Bucci
One day liquor license for Root NS, Inc., Harbor Point at Root, 35 Congress Street, Salem, November 19, 2026, 6pm – 9pm, 80 people
One day liquor license for Hamilton Hall, 9 Chestnut Street, Salem, December 19, 2026, 9:30pm – 12:30am, 350 people
One day liquor license for Hamilton Hall, 9 Chestnut Street, Salem, January 27, 2027, 6:30pm – 9:00pm, 75 people
